text:
Tumse kuch kehne ki chah me,
Kitni hi shaamein yunhi dhal gayi.
Dil ke kisi kone mein bas ek tu raha,
Aur baaki saari duniya badal gayi.
Na shikayat hai kisi se, na koi gila,
Bas khamoshi ka yeh safar hi humara sila.
title: Adhuri Baat
description: A soft and heartfelt reflection on unexpressed love that quietly lingers in the heart over time.
